mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of FEDFUNDS decline periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of UNRATE >4.5% periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of HOUST and RSAFS decline periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output stagnation (INDPRO growth <0.5% annually) signals supply constraints that reduce corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of INDPRO <0.5% growth periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL >3.0% YoY periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly real GDP growth above 2.0% signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of GDPC1 >2.0% growth periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth falling below 50,000 indicates weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of PAYEMS <50,000 growth periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate rises signal severe monetary tightening that triggers recessionary expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise periods or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year window.
